name: De'Voun Kendrick
strengths: Kendrick shows natural power at the point of attack and uses quick hands to shed after first contact.
Kendrick gets off the ball with sudden first-step quickness for a 6-4 / 300 frame.
Kendrick plays with a hot motor and pursues down the line after the initial rush stalls.
Kendrick redirects laterally without losing balance, flashing multi-tech interior flexibility.
weaknesses: Kendrick plays too upright at times, letting blockers into his chest and stalling his momentum.
comparison: Kendrick comps to Javon Kinlaw -- long, powerful interior DL with first-step juice who still needs hand/technique polish (size-matched to Kendrick's 6-4 / 300 mold).
projection: Kendrick projects as develop into the DL room, earn early rotational 3-tech snaps, then compete for a starting interior role -- starter upside as a power-and-quickness disruptor.
schemeFit: Kendrick fits White's interior as a penetrating 3-tech who can also occupy early downs.
insiderNotes: Kendrick shows natural power at the point and quick hands after first contact. Sudden first-step for a 6-4 / 300 frame, hot motor down the line, and lateral redirect without losing balance.
